analyst.summary: Dixon's FY26 headline (revenue +28%, PAT +33%) masks a weak Q4 (PAT -36% YoY) as PLI 1.0 rolls off and mobile-EMS margins compress; two real backward-integration catalysts (HKC display JV, Vivo OEM JV - both approved/signed, not MoU) support the medium-term margin and volume story but contribute little to FY27 numbers yet. Customer concentration (Xiaomi/Samsung/Motorola) and a rich ~50x PE leave little room for error. Q1 FY27 results not yet out as of 21-Jul-2026 (expected imminently on last year's late-July cadence) - catalyst ahead.
